name: Farmville Wholesale Electric Supply Co., Inc.
old_description: Farmville Wholesale Electric was founded in 1972 by Lynwood G. Smith of Farmville, Virginia. Mr. Smith, widely known as "Linnie", and his two brothers had previously established a contracting and retail firm known as Smitty Brothers Electric Company, which they owned for over forty years following World War II.  It was always Mr. Smith's dream, however, to be involved in the electrical business at the wholesale level.  That dream was realized through his two sons with the formation of FWESCO in 1972.  Mr. Smith went home to the Lord on January 17th, 2004.  He is dearly missed by all who knew him.
about:
Farmville Wholesale Electric Supply Co., Inc. operates from Farmville, Virginia, where it was founded in 1972 by Lynwood G. Smith, known locally as "Linnie." Smith and his two brothers had previously run Smitty Brothers Electric Company, a contracting and retail firm they owned for over four decades after World War II. Smith's long-held ambition to enter the wholesale electrical market was realized through his two sons with the formation of FWESCO.

The company functions as a wholesale electrical distributor with a 4,000-square-foot showroom and a dedicated sales counter. Its product range spans lighting fixtures such as chandeliers, ceiling fans, and outdoor lighting, along with a full line of electrical supplies. A virtual showroom allows customers to preview fixtures and layouts online before visiting in person.

The business serves both residential and commercial customers, including contractors and homeowners seeking lighting design assistance or electrical materials. Walk-in trade and project-based orders are handled through the sales counter, which offers wholesale pricing.

The company emphasizes personalized service from a knowledgeable staff, wholesale pricing, and the convenience of both a physical showroom and an online virtual tour as key differentiators.
